nodes.author: its_ShubhamK
nodes.text: We have already experienced the devastating impact of COVID-19, including lockdowns, economic hardships, and countless lives lost. We cannot afford to let history repeat itself. Public awareness campaigns, early testing, and timely treatment protocols should be prioritized to curb this virus in its early stages.

nodes.author: its_ShubhamK
nodes.text: It is just beginning, and we still have the chance to stop it. Let us work together as a community, follow health guidelines, and support the authorities in their efforts to prevent another health emergency. The time to act is now! #HMPV
